registration.title: Skill scores pulled towards the level a player plays at
registration.what: Each skill score moves by SKILL_LEVEL_PULL standard deviations for every 100 points his clubs' strength sits above or below the reference leagues' average, on top of the league offsets of MC-0031. Only the skill scores change.
registration.why: The owner, 2026-10-22: D. Markanday (League Two) still scores 97 in dribbling after MC-0031, and shouldn't if leagues are taken into account. The movers' data doesn't support a further cut, so it is the owner's judgement, as Ability's club-strength start is.
registration.how: skill_reference_level and the level pull in skill_scores, player_ratings.py; the strength set by the owner by eye from experiments/skill_level/report.py.
registration.hypothesis: None to test: a judgement. Lower-league skill scores come down and the strongest leagues' go up by the owner's chosen pull, with every rank as it was.
registration.success_criteria: A judgement: the owner sets the pull by eye from the report. Before release every rank, season rank, position rank, projection and predicted XI must be identical (report.py).

events.label: League Two regulars' average dribbling score (0 to 100) at the chosen pull, one way 0.75, against no pull; every rank and predicted XI identical
events.meaningful: A judgement: one way at 0.75 takes Markanday from 96.5 to 85 in dribbling and 88 to 76 in finishing, League Two's average dribbling from 49 to 19, the Premier League's from 60 to 76; V. van Dijk's dribbling rises from 14 to 48 as others move below him. Both-ways figures in report_both_ways.json

events.reason: Owner, 2026-10-22: one way, at 0.75, chosen by eye from the report. A judgement, as Ability's club-strength start is; not a tested improvement.

events.note: Released one way at the owner's setting, 0.75 (amendment 1), as MC-0034 on 2026-10-22.
